column1: # Zipangu (Mushroom Shrine) quests 4300-4309: the server's Quest.wz (MapleRoot data) gives them an end date of
# 2000-01-02, so the server refuses to start them (4309: to complete them). Stock Cosmic and the MapleLegends library
# have no date on them. Owner approved 2026-10-25: applied as a 1.5.2 deploy step (docs/release/1.5.2-deploy-steps.md).
# Moving the date only fixes the server side; if the client's own Quest.wz has the same date the client will still
# hide them, so check in a real client on TEST.
#   python3 tools/data-align/wz_set_values.py --wz <server wz dir> --tsv tools/data-align/zipangu-quest-dates.tsv --column new_value [--apply]
